description: Use when writing a new React UI component or growing an existing one and the rust-code-analysis complexity gate must pass first time — symptoms include the metrics target mapped by `make.lint_metrics` reporting lloc_function, nargs_function, cyclomatic, nom_functions_file, lloc_file or halstead_volume over its limit, a component file that has grown past roughly 120 logical lines, a render body doing hook wiring plus styling plus SVG, or a plan to split a component into files before the gate is run.
